verdict.rationale: Companies House is a public registry and API holding company and officer data, so asking whether users can control retention and deletion of their data is a fair privacy-posture question. Nothing in the evidence pack documents any retention policy, deletion request, or data-removal control. The pack covers only search, filing, address changes, identity verification and API access, none of which is about retention or deletion.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
